narrative.intro: Salus Worldwide Solutions has recorded $518M in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Salus Worldwide Solutions won 2 awards so far in the fiscal year, producing an average award size of $259M and driving obligations up 178.3% year over year. Salus Worldwide Solutions had $0 in obligations from FY21 through FY24, then $186M in FY25 before the current FY26 total. Salus Worldwide Solutions concentrates activity in air-transportation markets, with $512M in Nonscheduled Chartered Passenger Air Transportation and $5.7M in Other Support Activities for Air Transportation. The reported totals are partial, fiscal year to date, and the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables list award values as total contract values rather than obligations. Contract-count and average-award metrics show a small number of large awards are driving the fiscal-year increase. Contracting officers and program managers reviewing Salus Worldwide Solutions should focus on air-transportation tasking and the implications of two large awards when assessing vendor capacity and fiscal exposure for the remainder of the year.
